newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela tax revenues 3.3 pct ahead of target.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela tax revenues 3.3 pct ahead of target.

text.p: Venezuela's tax revenues over the eight months of the year were 3.3 percent ahead of forecast at 1.483 trillion bolivars ($3.1 billion), the National Taxation Superintendency (SENIAT) said Wednesday.
"In the period January-August the SENIAT brought in 1.483 trillion bolivars, compared to the target set of 1.435 trillion bolivars," SENIAT head Edgar Paredes Pisani told a news conference.
The SENIAT did not offer comparative figures for the same period in 1995.
